note: Golden expectations derived from Specifications/Solution-Spec.md Section 8; the run-tests checker (.claude/skills/run-tests/check.py) consumes this file. Asserted on STABLE invariants read through the product over MCP (the .dbsln is encrypted; built-in objects are excluded where they pollute raw totals). Derivation per .claude/skills/run-tests/tests-README.md: present-by-name for domain objects, exact counts only where re-take-stable, Min where the product adds rows, tolerant invariants for live values. Two Section 8 checks exceed the checker vocabulary and are verified manually in the run report (Tests/results/): (1) KPI/SpecificEnergy equals Plant/EnergyTotal / Plant/TreatedVolumeTotal within tolerance (cross-tag identity), and (2) forcing AIT603 above 1.0 NTU raises the Critical finished-water-turbidity alarm (active alarm-fire test).

tags.comment: Section 8: KPI/SpecificEnergy holds a good-quality value, timestamp recent. mustMove per Solution-Spec Section 4 (derived KPIs must hold live, moving values): both totalizer inputs integrate continuously, so the ratio drifts between two reads. The Section 8 ratio identity (= EnergyTotal / TreatedVolumeTotal within tolerance) is beyond the checker vocabulary and is verified manually in the run report.
Section 8: reads 100% while the simulation holds AIT603 inside its band. Constant by design while in-band, so no mustMove and no maxAgeSeconds (an equal write does not refresh the timestamp).
